app.name: Director Appointment
app.tagline: Request a meeting with the Director.

home.title: Meet the Director, the easy way
home.subtitle: Request an appointment from your phone, get your token number and track your turn live.
home.f1Text: Fill one short form. Your token number is ready in seconds.
home.f2Text: See the approval and your place in the queue on your phone.
home.f3Text: Know as soon as your request is approved, rescheduled or declined.
